subject: Myth & Symbolism
title: The Bull and Sacrifice
description: One-minute skill: The Bull and Sacrifice.

hook.text: Minoan Crete worshipped bulls. Mithras killed one in a cave. Egypt's Apis bull was a living god.

buildup.text: Bulls represent raw power, fertility, and untamed force. Controlling a bull proved your divine authority.

discovery.text: Mithras slaying the bull was Rome's most popular mystery cult image. From the bull's blood, life springs forth.

twist.text: When Israel worshipped a golden calf, Moses raged. The bull cult was so powerful that monotheism had to destroy it.

climax.text: Bull sacrifice was the most sacred act in ancient religion. Killing the strongest animal proved ultimate devotion.

punchline.text: Kill the strongest. Prove your faith.

quiz.question: What cult featured the ritual slaying of a bull in Rome?
